paragraphs: Week 13 (Dec 4 – 8, Lectures 25 and 26) Teaching and Learning

9.1 First-order differential equations (D.E.): overview; definition; solutions; slope fields; Euler’s method (Euler’s method will not be in the final exam --- students only need to know the big idea).
7.4 and 9.2 Solving separable D.E. and first-order linear D.E.: general techniques.
9.3 Applications of first-order D.E.: growth models; mixture problems.
9.4 Graphical solutions and autonomous equations: equilibrium values and phase lines; stable and unstable equilibria; Newton’s law of cooling; logistic growth model.
it is OK to shuffle the contents above around in an order you prefer and feel free to add in your own stuff, so long as the non-optional topics are all covered.
Feel free to go faster but aim not to be slower.
